title: AAPL Stock Impact Report for 05/01/2018 | News Quantified
text: Last apple earnings: 2/1 04:30 pm Check Earnings Report US:NASDAQ Investor Relations: investor.apple.com PDF Nasdaq turns positive as Apple shares rise The Nasdaq Composite Index turned positive in morning trading on Tuesday, shaking off an early decline as shares in Apple rose to their highs of the session. The index COMP, -0.08% rose 0.1%, with Apple AAPL, +0.97% up 1.7%. The iPhone maker is scheduled to report its quarterly results after the market closes. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.01% fell 0.7% on Tuesday while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.46% lost 0.2%. The Dow was on track for its fourth straight daily decline. Among the factors weighing on stocks on Tuesday was construction spending, which fell 1.7% in March from February. [Read more] IMPACT SNAPSHOT
